primaryContrast.metric: (LLM participation rate at high cost - at low cost) - (reference probability at high cost - at low cost)

failurePolicy: Stop session on invalid response, retain it, never code as refusal or silently replace. Preserve missing/interrupted records and conservative reservations; no repair retries. Transport retries at most 3 attempts per choice. Resume may repeat unknown-result interruptions, with old reservation retained.
multiplicityPolicy: One declared primary contrast; pointwise descriptive intervals; all other comparisons exploratory, no unadjusted family significance claims
explanationReview: Prespecified exploratory manual review of repetition indices 0,49,99 in each of 30 eligible states (90 choices). Raw SHA256-bound judgments; no action relabeling/exclusion. Non-reviewed explanations are not assumed correct.
repetitionsJustification: 100 planned outputs/state fixed before formal collection: maximum pointwise Wilson 95% half-width about 0.0962 conditional on 100 valid independent outputs. This is a descriptive precision target, not power for detecting effects. No early stopping, sample-size adaptation or filling invalid slots based on outcomes.

modelLifecycleReview.limitation: Reported alias, not an immutable backend snapshot. A matching alias cannot exclude unannounced backend changes. Capture request/response identifiers and timestamps; stop on reported provider drift. Do not silently replace model.

scenarioRationale: Retain the preregistered 3x3x3 multiplayer grid, three single-player boundary states and two no-game controls. Do not expand or tune prompts to obtain desired non-cooperation after the all-participate development pilot.

sampling.independenceLimitation: Each request has two fresh messages and no memory/history. Provider-side independence and stationarity are assumptions, not verified properties. orderSeed randomizes work ordering only; it is not a provider response seed.

stopping: Stop on first invalid saved response, reported provider drift, source mismatch, wall-clock interruption or exhausted reservation budget. Preserve all slots and failures. No response-repair retry or replacement of saved invalid choices. Stop at the fixed planned workload, never at desired significance/cooperation.
primaryReporting: Observed high-minus-low participation change minus the deterministic reference change at X=5,tau=.5,av=.5,omega=5. Newcombe-Wilson pointwise interval; no confirmatory tests or multiplicity-wide coverage claim.
secondaryReporting: All states, conditional response curves, one-factor exploratory contrasts, invalid/missing sensitivity bounds and separately stratified single-player boundaries. No-game controls are not refusals.

prerequisites.factualEvidenceLimitation: Ten-rule and eight-payoff assessments reused from prior v5/Luna factual suites; factual response schema is separate and unchanged. Fresh P-023 semantic gate and v3 sampling pilot required; old v1 action data not used as a current-protocol pilot.

closedLoop: Not part of this lock. Requires separate scenario/horizon design, closed-loop pilot, independently collected RandomMatched calibration and a new final-test gate. Fixed-state observations cannot establish evacuation outcomes.
semanticGatePolicy: New registered P-023 gate must pass; formal primary endpoint remains raw action. Numerical explanations are secondary and never repair or exclude choices.
registrationRationale: Retain original scenario grid and primary contrast despite prior all-C results; response-v3 is a new study version, no outcome-adaptive sample size or prompt tuning.
